title: Retain the corrected swap-wait-swap advantage over the tested hump
statement: After restoring phase accumulated during swaps and correcting physical rail assignment,the response reports ideal SWS0.449329microseconds/0.438486%mean leading loss versus best tested positive hump0.668941microseconds/0.522443%,19.15%worse. Source literature examples are not newly acquired experiments

contract.units: Dimensionless half-diamond error and fidelity; oscillator time converts using angular frequency omega, not cycles. SI examples explicitly assume 5 GHz. Component values are model designs; losses are declared-model probabilities, not measurements.
